milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate/observe' task. The player must navigate near the red concrete powder block (placed at [7, 0, 0] spawn-relative, i.e., 7 blocks east of spawn at ground level) and be facing toward it, modeling that the player has visually located and is looking at the target block. max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable exploration distance (sandbox showed agent identified it from ~7 blocks away), and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the block rather than just passing nearby.
